references.text: Refers to a large crowd following Jesus because they saw the signs he performed on the sick, a direct parallel to the situation in John 6:2.
Describes a large crowd that came to hear him and be healed, and who followed him, reflecting the motif in John 6:2 of the multitude following because of the healings.
Mentions that many believed in his name when they saw the signs he performed, a motif that also underlies why the crowd follows Jesus in John 6:2.
